mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM users WHERE phone = #{phone}
SELECT COUNT(1) > 0 FROM users WHERE email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (phone, email, password_hash, nickname, avatar, bio, tags_json) VALUES (#{phone}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{nickname}, #{avatar}, #{bio}, #{tagsJson})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
